subject.title: Dashboard: editable notes / todo / markdown widget (stateful)

question: Should the persistent notes/todo/markdown widget be bundled into OpenClaw after the dashboard write-back stack is accepted, or should it live as an external ClawHub/plugin widget?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing dashboard capability and depends on a still-unlanded persistent widget-state boundary; automation can identify the implementation path but cannot choose bundled scope or approve the storage/security tradeoff.

options.title: Bundle After Write-Back
options.body: Keep this issue open and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101829 only after the write-back predecessor and storage/security contract are accepted.

options.title: Move To ClawHub
options.body: Treat the notes pad as an optional widget/plugin package once the public dashboard/widget API is sufficient.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Builtins
options.body: Leave the issue open but pause implementation until maintainers sponsor the broader modular dashboard roadmap.

recommendation.title: Bundle After Write-Back
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101829 only after the write-back predecessor and storage/security contract are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-main routing signal for the plugin-tab seam and repository policy tradeoffs that affect bundled dashboard scope.
